editorial: The dry season is the easiest time for a first visit, particularly if you are combining Monteverde with beaches or road travel.
That said, a cloud forest without clouds would be missing the point. Monteverde stays lush precisely because moisture is part of the ecosystem, so some mist and rain are features rather than bugs.
If lower prices and fewer visitors matter more than perfect skies, shoulder months can work well. Just build flexibility into outdoor plans.
